nativeSettingsDecision.decision: Retain complete native page/provider obligation. Route construction does not place these six entries under oZ; page-internal admission and effective capability values remain separate.

childSpecifications.name: selected-loading
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: Return null while the selected capability loads; no child or redirect yet.

childSpecifications.name: seat-loading
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: Return null even when the selected capability denies.

childSpecifications.name: seat-screen-precedence
childSpecifications.precondition: allowWork=false; both settled; seat capable; selected incapable
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: Render ChatSeatAccessScreen before the denial redirect.

childSpecifications.name: seat-bypass
childSpecifications.precondition: allowWork=true; selected capable; seat loading or capable
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: Wrap children in Suspense; seat state does not block this branch.

childSpecifications.name: selected-denied
childSpecifications.precondition: Selected settled/incapable; no active seat screen

childSpecifications.name: capability-error
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: oZ reads loading/capable only; do not invent an isError-specific screen.

childSpecifications.name: missing-feature
childSpecifications.precondition: Config feature list loaded; requested feature absent
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: The evaluator config-feature branch accepts enabled!==false; do not default this branch to denial.

childSpecifications.name: work-access
childSpecifications.expectedSourceBehavior: Wait/children/home/home respectively; preserve the actual status provider.

engineeringAdoption.responsibility: Existing router/route-table preparation must preserve capability gates as conditional contracts, separate from product-mode stripping.
engineeringAdoption.runtimeRouteDecision: No new qualified provider. Keep independent capability adapters and all RAM-01..15 obligations; neither stock Electron nor an omitted page establishes equivalence.

limitations: A gate category describes the selected explicit route element/ancestor topology only. Components may enforce additional guards, including qPs/images and other internally wrapped pages.
The two map inputs of the dynamic nIs route template remain template inputs, not two new canonical routes. The settings map likewise remains parameterized.
Capability names and allowWork do not establish the current product mode. Known workCloud alternative is reused from the pinned guard review; no provider is re-evaluated.
No whole file/module can be removed from a route gate alone. Other importers, non-route consumers, side effects and shared state require their own retention decisions.
No target execution, VM replay, browser/client launch, model/service call, personal data access, build or product acceptance.
